report: Facebook is the top impact priority, with an estimated 18.2-enrollment gap: it contributes 54.21% of leads but 30.26% of enrollments, with L2W identified as its weakest stage; Others ranks next at a 3.52 gap, contributing 17.79% of leads versus 13.16% of enrollments, with A2E weakest. Google and database are relative strengths at 2.95% and 2.66% L2E and zero estimated gaps, although W2A is their weakest stage, while LinkedIn has only a 0.41 gap and A2E as its weakest stage. These benchmark gaps are counterfactual prioritization estimates—not demonstrated causes or guaranteed recoverable enrollments—and cost comparisons are limited because spend is available for only 3 of 8 sources (37.5% coverage; observed sum ₹2,555,383), with missing spend not interpretable as zero.
